data.name: HomeIntro
data.value: This is where your digital emergency folder takes shape: insurance policies, accounts, contracts, certificates and wishes in one safe place. Everything is encrypted in your browser, so only you and, in an emergency, your trusted persons can read it.

data.name: HomeNextStepsText
data.value: Next up: sign-in with a second factor and the encrypted vault.

data.name: HomeStatusUnreachable
data.value: The server cannot be reached. Please try again later.

data.name: NotFoundText
data.value: The page you requested does not exist.

data.name: NotInVaultIntro
data.value: myLife tells your family what exists and where to find it. Credentials that give someone immediate access to money do not belong in it:

data.name: NotInVaultOriginals
data.value: Original certificates, only where they are filed

data.name: NotInVaultPasswords
data.value: Individual passwords. Name your password manager instead and where its emergency access is kept.

data.name: NotInVaultPins
data.value: PINs, TANs and full card numbers

data.name: NotInVaultSeeds
data.value: Cryptocurrency seed phrases, only the place where they are kept

data.name: NotInVaultTitle
data.value: What does not belong in myLife?

data.name: NotInVaultWhy
data.value: myLife warns you when something you enter looks like one of these.

data.name: RecoveryKitInstructions
data.value: To regain access to your vault: choose “Forgot password” on the sign-in page and enter the 24 words or scan the QR code. Then set a new master password.

data.name: RecoveryKitWarning
data.value: Anyone who knows these words can open your vault. Do not photograph them or store them digitally.

data.name: SetupAccountText
data.value: As administrator you manage settings and users. You still cannot look into anyone else's vault.

data.name: SetupAlreadyDone
data.value: myLife has already been set up.

data.name: SetupDisplayNameRequired
data.value: Please enter a name (at most 100 characters).

data.name: SetupEmailHelp
data.value: Used for signing in, for reminders and for emergency access.

data.name: SetupEmailInvalid
data.value: Please enter a valid email address.

data.name: SetupErrorCrypto
data.value: The keys could not be created in your browser. Please use an up-to-date browser.

data.name: SetupError_setup-already-completed
data.value: myLife has already been set up.

data.name: SetupError_setup-invalid-input
data.value: Some entries are invalid. Please check them.

data.name: SetupError_setup-invalid-token
data.value: The setup code is not correct. A new code is issued whenever the container restarts.

data.name: SetupError_setup-rate-limited
data.value: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute.

data.name: SetupError_setup-totp-expired
data.value: Setting up the second factor has expired. Please scan the new QR code.

data.name: SetupError_setup-totp-invalid-code
data.value: The code is not correct. Please check the time on your phone and try again.

data.name: SetupFinishDoneText
data.value: From now on you sign in with your email address, your master password and the code from your authenticator app.

data.name: SetupFinishText
data.value: Everything is ready. Your browser creates the keys when you continue. This takes a few seconds.

data.name: SetupPasswordAcknowledge
data.value: I understand that nobody can reset my master password.

data.name: SetupPasswordHelp
data.value: At least {0} characters. A sentence of several words is both memorable and secure.

data.name: SetupPasswordText
data.value: The master password decrypts your vault. Nobody can reset it, not even the administrator. If you lose it, only the recovery kit from the next step can help.

data.name: SetupRecoveryConfirmText
data.value: To check: enter the words at these positions.

data.name: SetupRecoveryStored
data.value: I have printed or written down the kit and stored it safely.

data.name: SetupRecoveryText
data.value: These 24 words get you into your vault if you forget the master password. Print the kit or write the words down and keep it separate from the password, for example in a safe deposit box.

data.name: SetupStepNotInVault
data.value: What does not belong in it

data.name: SetupTokenHelp
data.value: Shown in the container log, for example in Container Manager under mylife-app → Log. A new code is issued after every restart.

data.name: SetupTwoFactorPasskeyLater
data.value: You can add a passkey after you first sign in.

data.name: SetupTwoFactorText
data.value: To sign in you also need a code from an authenticator app such as Aegis, Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or your password manager. Scan the QR code and enter the code shown.

data.name: SetupWelcomeText
data.value: This instance has not been set up yet. You are about to create the first account. It becomes the administrator and gets its own vault. All keys are created in your browser; the server only ever sees encrypted data.
